text: Halloran practically lives in that lab. Ben Ashworth does the odd evening test run. Always behind, always skint, that lad.
style: Systems administrator in his late twenties. Speak with a consistent Manchester accent throughout — do not shift to any other accent. Mid-range pitch; quick, energetic pace. Friendly and a bit frazzled, sardonic about the state of the network, relieved someone competent has turned up.
